sections.content: You know *más… que*, *menos… que* and *tan… como* from A2 Unit 6, and *recomendar que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 4. Here you use them together to compare options and recommend one: *es mejor* / *sería mejor* + infinitive, or *te recomiendo que* + subjunctive.

items.spanish: Esta opción es más barata que la otra.
items.english: This option is cheaper than the other one.

items.spanish: La segunda opción es tan práctica como la primera.
items.english: The second option is as practical as the first.

items.spanish: Creo que sería mejor elegir la primera.
items.english: I think it would be better to choose the first one.

items.spanish: Te recomiendo que compares los costes antes de decidir.
items.english: I recommend that you compare the costs before deciding.

sections.content: Remember: *recomendar que* takes the subjunctive (*que compares*), while *sería mejor* is followed by a plain infinitive (*elegir*) when no particular person is named.
